styles.name: Signature Waves
styles.description: Soft, effortless waves with natural movement.
styles.aiInstruction: Transform the hair into long 22-inch soft loose waves with natural movement and body. The waves should be effortless and flowing, with subtle volume throughout.
styles.stylistRecommendation: This look adds soft movement and volume while keeping the overall silhouette natural. Perfect for everyday elegance.

styles.name: Silk Straight
styles.description: Sleek, polished length with a smooth finish.
styles.aiInstruction: Transform the hair into long 24-inch sleek straight hair with a polished, smooth finish. The hair should fall smoothly with a glossy, salon-quality appearance.
styles.stylistRecommendation: Silk straight creates a refined, polished look that frames the face beautifully. Ideal for a sophisticated, timeless style.

styles.name: Soft Layers
styles.aiInstruction: Transform the hair into 20-inch layered cut with face-framing layers and natural-looking volume. The layers should be soft and blended for a lived-in feel.
styles.stylistRecommendation: Soft layers add dimension and movement without overwhelming your features. A versatile choice that works for most face shapes.

styles.name: Modern Bob
styles.description: A clean, contemporary bob with effortless shape.
styles.aiInstruction: Transform the hair into a clean 12-inch contemporary bob with a blunt or slightly angled cut. The bob should have effortless shape and a modern, polished finish.
styles.stylistRecommendation: The modern bob is bold yet refined. It draws attention to your jawline and neck, creating a striking, confident silhouette.

styles.name: Defined Curls
styles.description: Full, defined curls with soft natural volume.
styles.aiInstruction: Transform the hair into long 20-inch defined curls with soft natural volume. The curls should be bouncy, well-formed, and have realistic texture and shine.
styles.stylistRecommendation: Defined curls bring warmth and personality to your look. This style celebrates natural texture with premium definition and bounce.

styles.name: Rich Brunette
styles.aiInstruction: Transform the hair color to a rich dimensional espresso-brunette with subtle highlights and lowlights. Maintain the existing hairstyle but enhance with a luxurious multi-tonal brunette finish.
styles.stylistRecommendation: Rich brunette adds depth and dimension to any style. The espresso tones create a warm, sophisticated look that complements most skin tones.
